newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end lower at 20.00 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end lower at 20.00 percent.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates finished slightly lower on Wednesday in abundant liquidity, traders said.
Overnight rates closed at around 20.00 percent, compared with Tuesday's close of 20.25 percent.
"Rates are falling because the banks have plenty of funds at the end of the reserve period," said Gabor Liener of Unicbank.
Dealers said they saw no factors to raise rates above current levels over the next few days.
